crypto_headlines.title: Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs shed about $530M as tech stocks sell off
crypto_headlines.summary: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $430.2M in net outflows on Nov 5, led by Fidelity's FBTC at $199.9M and BlackRock's IBIT at $105M; Ethereum ETFs lost about $100M. Bitcoin traded near $76,000 on Nov 6 after the Nasdaq's 5.5% drop.

crypto_headlines.title: Crypto liquidations top $1 billion in the Nov 5 selloff
crypto_headlines.summary: More than $1 billion in leveraged crypto positions were liquidated over 24 hours as Bitcoin fell from above $80,000 toward the mid-$70,000s alongside the tech-stock rout.

crypto_headlines.title: Binance targets more withdrawal reopenings by next week
crypto_headlines.summary: After covering the October hot-wallet theft from company funds, Binance said it aims to reopen withdrawals for HYPE, INJ, APT, PLASMA, NEAR and LTC by the end of next week, with several networks already restored.

crypto_headlines.title: Amundi launches a tokenized European equity fund on Ethereum
crypto_headlines.summary: Europe's largest asset manager partnered with CACEIS on a tokenized share class of its Core STOXX Europe 600 index fund on Ethereum, extending its earlier tokenized money-market product.

crypto_headlines.title: Schroders brings an emerging-markets bond fund onchain via Solana
crypto_headlines.summary: Schroders launched an onchain share class of its Schroder International Selection Fund Emerging Market Bond with Centrifuge on Solana, giving eligible investors digital access to EM sovereign and corporate bonds.

crypto_headlines.title: Solana Labs launches Leap, a mobile trading app for Solana assets
crypto_headlines.summary: Solana Labs opened Leap on iOS TestFlight for trading tokenized stocks, ETFs, crypto and memecoins on Solana, with no platform fees at launch and trades routed through partners such as Jupiter.

doginal_news.title: Floor held at 47k DOGE with zero listings through the red day
doginal_news.summary: Community tracker BradX reports the Doginal Dogs floor stayed at 47k DOGE with 0 listed through Thursday's majors selloff, with no fills since #495 at 115k on Tuesday; 30-day volume about 1.59M DOGE across 23 trades.

doginal_news.title: Pyth October report: $13.67M ARR, up 18.9% month over month
doginal_news.summary: Pyth Network posted its October 2026 report: ARR at $13.67M (+18.9% MoM), 332 paying accounts, 4,451 Terminal signups, $2.17M net new ARR, and Indices feeds growing from 50 to 77.

doginal_news.title: PIRB: PYTH recovering after the dump; perps report due next week
doginal_news.summary: Pyth's community account says PYTH is restoring positions after the market dump and that first-party data already previews an upcoming perps report for next week, quoting a post that Pyth priced $734B (88.5%) of RWA perp volume in October.

notes: No new original posts from @doginaldogs or @DDLTCG in the last ~24 hours. No news on Toot, Atlas or Boogie. Floor note is community tracking, not an official listing figure.
